_about: The Empire goal list after Act 1 (Alex, approved 2026-11-18; docs/REVIEW_2026-11-24.md section 2 and section 7's pacing: Act 1 is about 25 game days, so one goal every two days or so, the last near day 25). scripts/empire_goals.gd shows the first three not yet done, top left, and any of them can be done. Each has an id, a line (every line is a DRAFT until Alex approves it), a check the code reads, n (how many; default 1) and a reward in coins (drafts, 20 to 150c). Checks: caught, penned, combed, fibre_knits, face_sales, requests count from the moment the goal first shows (so what she did in Act 1 doesn't tick it off); needles (has that pair or better), pens (that many pens), barn (Lars's barn rented and paid up), guide_seen (species seen in the Field Guide), designs (designs knitted for the Lookbook), best_day (coins from sweaters in one day, the morning ledger's best), ready (the last one: sets Game.flags["act_ready"] for the time skip). 'act' is the act a goal belongs to (1 when it's missing; scripts/acts.gd): only the current act's goals show, each act ending in its own ready goal (ids are kept across acts, so each needs its own). Acts 2 and 3 have a few placeholders ('draft': true), all counted checks, so nothing she already has ticks them off the moment the act begins; Act 4 has none (it is the choice, built later).
